reviewer: Codex visual inspection after full-plate identity correction
scope: Eight exact PNGs:seven native previews and full HB/SNL comparison including the rejected first section. Qualitative arrangement review, independent panel scales.
findings: Full SNL callout28 identifiesSH998Bthrust collar at the main bearing end;callout30 identifies the small externalSH861Esnap ring aft of it. The revised native now contains both distinct parts in that order.

The corrected axial and retention sections show the larger thrust collar with an inner plug, front disk and outer lip, and the separate thin external ring in a matching outside groove. The erroneous internal retaining ridge/groove is gone.

The long relieved bearing and overlapping sleeve follow the catalogue nesting. The sleeve is obscured in the external internals view but its24straight internal grooves are visible in the isolated sleeve view.

Four keys occupy actual receiving beds under the cone-support collar. The exposed-key view shows the two near-side keys; all four physical occurrences and their source quantity are independently checked.

Installed and mechanism isometrics retain the external spring and wired collar joint. No obvious disconnected support or unintended collision is visible; the crankshaft, cones, ball reaction and small spring sets remain absent.
The source comparison preserves the rejected first-core section rather than quietly relabeling it. Original opposite source orientations remain; panel scales do not establish metrology.
remaining_discrepancies: The literal HB0.75in radial key thickness produces thicker bands than the SNL drawing. Axis interpretation and applicability remain unresolved.
HB/SNL sleeve/bearing/ring marks differ. BearingOD152mm, stepped bores, support contours and stations remain estimates;HB4.684in bearingOD is not applied.
Thrust-collar attachment, its unfinished ball race/reaction, external-ring section/split and elastic installation are not qualified.
